decisions.reason: Having remained in the portfolio after launch and fitting the firm's core automation system offer, it is likely to stay unless its performance clearly falls below aspiration levels.

Although it overlaps partly with broader robot solutions, management would likely retain it because it serves customers wanting stepwise automation and there is no clear signal of results below aspirations.
This specialized storage robot faces the greatest demand uncertainty in the set, but the firm's broad range and innovation slack still make continued market presence more likely than withdrawal.
As a modular automation product within tailored precast plant solutions, it would likely be kept while management compares its results with internal expectations and peer offerings.
The new multi-model machine extends the firm's integrated equipment platform and would likely be given time to build orders before any withdrawal decision is made.

Production analysis software is strategically complementary to the firm's machinery and lifecycle support business, so management would likely keep it unless adoption markedly underperforms aspirations.
